cards.example_en: Miss Chen is our English teacher.
cards.example_zh: 陈老师是我们的英语老师。

cards.example_en: One spelling mistake cost him a mark on the dictation.
cards.example_zh: 一个拼写错误让他在听写里丢了一分。

cards.example_en: Stir the mix until the flour disappears into the milk.
cards.example_zh: 把混合料搅拌到面粉完全融进牛奶里。

cards.example_en: My mobile phone buzzed during the quiet exam.
cards.example_zh: 安静的考试中，我的手机突然震动了。

cards.example_en: The clay model of the volcano cracked while it was drying.
cards.example_zh: 火山的黏土模型在晾干时裂开了。

cards.example_en: The modern gym has bright lights and new machines.
cards.example_zh: 这座现代体育馆灯光很亮，还有新器械。

cards.example_en: For a moment nobody spoke after the captain scored.
cards.example_zh: 队长进球之后，有那么一会儿谁都没有说话。

cards.example_en: Count your money before you pay for the train ticket.
cards.example_zh: 买火车票之前，先把钱数清楚。

cards.example_en: The monkey jumped from tree to tree.
cards.example_zh: 猴子在树间跳来跳去。

cards.example_en: This month has five weekends, so we planned two picnics.
cards.example_zh: 这个月有五个周末，所以我们安排了两次野餐。

cards.example_en: We could see the moon above the rooftops after supper.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们能看见屋顶上方的月亮。

cards.example_en: Would you like more rice?
cards.example_zh: 你还想要米饭吗？

cards.example_en: A foggy morning delayed the school bus by twenty minutes.
cards.example_zh: 有雾的早晨让校车晚点了二十分钟。

cards.example_en: Most of my friends live near school.
cards.example_zh: 我的大多数朋友住在学校附近。

cards.example_en: His mother woke him early for the trip to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 他母亲一早就叫醒他，好去博物馆。

cards.example_en: We climbed the mountain on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 我们星期六爬山。

cards.example_en: Our cat chased a mouse across the kitchen late at night.
cards.example_zh: 深夜，我们的猫在厨房里追一只老鼠。

cards.example_en: He burned his mouth on the hot dumpling and reached for water.
cards.example_zh: 热饺子烫到了他的嘴，他连忙去拿水。

cards.example_en: Could you move your chair so the aisle stays clear?
cards.example_zh: 你能把椅子挪一下，好让过道保持畅通吗？

cards.example_en: The movie ended so late that we missed the last bus.
cards.example_zh: 电影结束得太晚，我们错过了末班车。

cards.example_en: Mr Li coaches the basketball team.
cards.example_zh: 李老师执教篮球队。

cards.example_en: Mrs Wang lives next door.
cards.example_zh: 王太太住在隔壁。

cards.example_en: Ms Zhao will meet the parents tonight.
cards.example_zh: 赵女士今晚会见家长。

cards.example_en: There isn't much time left.
cards.example_zh: 剩下的时间不多了。

cards.example_en: Our history class spent the afternoon at the city museum.
cards.example_zh: 我们历史课的那个下午是在市博物馆度过的。

cards.example_en: Loud music from next door made it hard to do homework.
cards.example_zh: 隔壁的音乐声很大，作业很难写下去。

cards.example_en: You must wear a seat belt in the car.
cards.example_zh: 在车上你必须系安全带。

cards.example_en: This restaurant is famous for mutton.
cards.example_zh: 这家餐馆以羊肉出名。

cards.example_en: This is my favourite song.
cards.example_zh: 这是我最喜欢的歌。

cards.example_en: I made this card myself.
cards.example_zh: 这张卡片是我自己做的。

cards.example_en: Write your full name clearly on the cover of the notebook.
cards.example_zh: 把你的全名清楚地写在笔记本封面上。

cards.example_en: The narrow lane behind the school is too tight for cars.
cards.example_zh: 学校后面的窄巷子，汽车开不进去。

cards.example_en: People across the nation watched the final on television.
cards.example_zh: 全国各地的人都在电视上看了决赛。

cards.example_en: Camping lets children see nature away from busy streets.
cards.example_zh: 露营能让孩子们离开热闹的街道，看见自然。

cards.example_en: There is a bus stop near my home.
cards.example_zh: 我家附近有公交站。

cards.example_en: It is nearly six o'clock.
cards.example_zh: 快六点了。

cards.example_en: Warm coats are necessary when the winter wind is strong.
cards.example_zh: 冬天风大时，厚外套是必要的。

cards.example_en: The scarf slipped from her neck when she ran for the bus.
cards.example_zh: 她追公交车时，围巾从脖子上滑了下来。

cards.example_en: Plants on the classroom windowsill need water and sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 教室窗台上的植物需要水和阳光。

cards.example_en: Try not to give a negative reply before you listen.
cards.example_zh: 听别人说完之前，尽量不要给出否定的答复。

cards.example_en: Our neighbour has a big dog.
cards.example_zh: 我们的邻居养了一只大狗。

cards.example_en: Neither answer is correct.
cards.example_zh: 两个答案都不对。

cards.example_en: I was nervous before my first speech.
cards.example_zh: 第一次演讲前我很紧张。

cards.example_en: I never forget my keys.
cards.example_zh: 我从不忘带钥匙。

cards.example_en: I bought a new pair of trainers for PE.
cards.example_zh: 我买了一双新运动鞋，上体育课穿。

cards.example_en: Good news arrived: our school team reached the city final.
cards.example_zh: 好消息来了：我们校队进入了市决赛。

cards.example_en: He folded the newspaper and caught the bus to work.
cards.example_zh: 他叠好报纸，赶上了去上班的公交车。

cards.example_en: Next week we have a school trip.
cards.example_zh: 下周我们有学校郊游。

cards.example_en: Mrs Lee is nice and always greets us at the gate.
cards.example_zh: 李老师人很好，总是在校门口跟我们打招呼。

cards.example_en: The night was cold, so we stayed inside the tent.
cards.example_zh: 黑天很冷，所以我们待在帐篷里面。

word.example_en: I took his book by mistake.
I am busy at the moment.
She wants to make money for a new bike.
word.example_zh: 她想赚钱买一辆新自行车。

word.example_en: More than twenty people came to help.
The two bags are more or less the same.
I do not eat sweets any more.
The more you read, the more you learn.
word.example_zh: 你读得越多，学到的就越多。

word.example_en: I brush my teeth in the morning.
The bag costs twenty yuan at most.
We collected coats for people in need.
word.example_zh: 我们为困境中的人募集了外套。

word.example_en: The plant is in need of water.
Neither the bus nor the taxi has come.
word.example_zh: 公交车和出租车都还没来。

word.example_en: I am nervous about the oral test.
I sit next to the window.
The nurses work day and night.
word.example_zh: 护士们日日夜夜地工作。
